description: Summarize a table with a pivot table: group by one or more columns, and total, count or average others. It goes on a new tab unless anchor_cell is given. The source range needs a header row; refer to columns by header name or letter.

account.description: Google account to use: an email or unique part of one (e.g. "acme.com"). Default: the account that can open the spreadsheet, else the default account.

anchor_cell.description: Top-left cell for the pivot table, e.g. "Summary!A1". The area below and right of it must be empty. Default: a new tab

columns.description: Columns to group by across the top

new_tab_name.description: Name for the new tab when anchor_cell isn't given

rows.description: Columns to group by down the side, e.g. ["Region"]

source_range.description: The table to summarize, header row included, e.g. "Orders!A1:F500" or a tab name

spreadsheet.description: Google Sheets link or spreadsheet ID. The name of a spreadsheet used with Sheets MCP before also works

summarize.description: COUNTA counts non-empty cells; COUNT counts numbers

name: add_pivot_table
title: Add a pivot table
